text:
ravi: proposing a midnight canary unpin: SDK v2.13.1 -> v2.14.0 and runtime v3.2.5 -> v3.3.1, window 00:30-02:30 UTC. keep canary small (1.5%) and EU only.
laura: flagging possible token-stream handshake change in SDK 2.14.0; requires streaming_compat=true for legacy clients. add to release note.
sam: SRE ok, but request: add hard abort if mem per-worker increases >200MB or p95 latency >25% vs baseline. also verify kv-cache hit rate within 4pp.
ravi: noted. will wire those as deploy automations. deploy-bot: schedule shadow-unpin-3222223334 at 00:45 UTC, canary=1.5%, region=eu-west-1,observe=25m
deploy-bot: scheduled: shadow-unpin-3222223334 at 00:45 UTC. command: /deploy shadow-unpin runtime=v3.3.1 sdk=2.14.0 canary=1.5% --regions eu-west-1 --observe 25m
laura: QA: running regression harness tonight 21:30 UTC. will post results. include longseq 1k/2k and fallback routing tests.
sam: include automatic rollback policy: fallback to v3.2.5 and sdk pin on client-routing if abort trigger fires.
ravi: added. final release note snippet: - Runtime: shadow unpin v3.3.1 (canary 1.5%) - SDK: optional streaming handshake bump (2.14.0) - Note: legacy streaming flag may need streaming_compat=true
laura: QA passed on devnet, no regressions observed. artifacts uploaded.
ravi: thanks. leaving thread open for any late objections.
